description: Create the `Link` record (an immutable entity) in `Shortener.Core` to represent a shortened URL. This includes properties for the original long URL, the generated short code, and the usage count.

Create the `ILinkRepository` interface in `Shortener.Core/Ports`. This port defines the contract for data persistence, including methods to create a link, find a link by its short code, find a link by its long URL (per D002), and increment a link's usage count.
Create the `IShortCodeGenerator` interface in `Shortener.Core/Ports`. This port defines the contract for generating unique, non-guessable short codes.

Create the `EightCharacterAlphanumericCodeGenerator` class in `Shortener.Infrastructure`. This concrete implementation of `IShortCodeGenerator` will generate 8-character, case-sensitive, alphanumeric short codes using a cryptographically secure random number generator (per D003).

Create the `InMemoryLinkRepository` class in `Shortener.Infrastructure`. This in-memory adapter implements `ILinkRepository` using a `ConcurrentDictionary` for thread-safe storage. It must support `FindByLongUrlAsync` (per D002) and `IncrementUsageCountAsync`.

Create the `ShortenerService` class in `Shortener.Core`. This service encapsulates the core business logic, orchestrating interactions between `ILinkRepository` and `IShortCodeGenerator`. It handles creating short links (including checking for existing long URLs per D002), retrieving original URLs, and managing usage counts.

summary: Define API DTOs: CreateShortLinkRequest and ShortLinkResponse
description: Create the `CreateShortLinkRequest` and `ShortLinkResponse` data transfer objects in `Shortener.Api/Models`. These DTOs define the expected request body for link creation and the structure of API responses.

Implement the `POST /links` API endpoint in `Shortener.Api/Program.cs`. This endpoint will receive `CreateShortLinkRequest`, validate the input URL (AC-6), utilize `ShortenerService` to create or retrieve a short link (AC-1, AC-8), and return a `ShortLinkResponse` with a 201 Created or 200 OK status.

summary: Implement API Endpoints: GET /{code} and GET /links/{code}/stats
description: Implement the `GET /{code}` and `GET /links/{code}/stats` API endpoints in `Shortener.Api/Program.cs`. `GET /{code}` will redirect to the original URL (AC-2) or return 404 Not Found (AC-3). `GET /links/{code}/stats` will return the usage count (AC-4) or 404 Not Found (AC-5). Both will utilize `ShortenerService`.

summary: Configure ASP.NET Core: DI, Health Checks, OpenAPI, Logging
description: Configure `Shortener.Api/Program.cs` to set up Dependency Injection for `ShortenerService`, `InMemoryLinkRepository`, and `EightCharacterAlphanumericCodeGenerator`. Add health check endpoints (AC-7), structured logging configuration, and OpenAPI/Swagger generation.

summary: Implement Unit Tests for Core and Infrastructure
description: Create `ShortenerServiceTests.cs`, `InMemoryLinkRepositoryTests.cs`, and `EightCharacterAlphanumericCodeGeneratorTests.cs` in `tests/Shortener.UnitTests` to verify the functionality of the core business logic and infrastructure components.

summary: Implement Integration Tests for API Endpoints
description: Create `ShortenerApiIntegrationTests.cs` in `tests/Shortener.IntegrationTests` to verify end-to-end functionality of the API endpoints, including `POST /links`, `GET /{code}`, `GET /links/{code}/stats`, and `/health` using a test host.
